episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After receiving a call from Hong Hui Ju's kidnapper, Baek Sa Eon attempts to learn more about him — only to find it's hard to escape his surveillance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Sa-eon works quickly to track down the caller, forcing Hee-joo to stay extra vigilant. Despite her fears, she continues to play along with the ruse.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After Sa Eon experiences an attack, he grows wary of Hui Ju's relationship with her friend. Meanwhile, an ominous figure makes his presence known.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After receiving the ominous call, Hee-joo abandons her clandestine plan. She then undergoes a tough interview with Sa-eon — sharing an intimate moment.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Sa Eon grapples with feelings of betrayal after learning the truth about Hui Ju. However, when she receives good news, they begin to grow fonder.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hui Ju confronts a figure from her past who wishes to reveal what she knows. She then embarks on a retreat with Sa Eeon — who becomes possessive of her.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Sa Eon and Hui Ju's relationship shifts after her harrowing rescue. Determined to catch the kidnapper, Sa Eon goes full force — with the help of 406.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As Hui Ju and Sa Eon grow closer, the threat from the kidnapper intensifies. Sa Eon discovers an ominous and shocking clue from a past figure.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hee-joo worries about Sa-eon after learning the truth about him. She later appears on the stage of her dreams, side by side with her love.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: As Hui Ju and Sa Eon grow closer, the threat from the kidnapper intensifies. Sa Eon discovers an ominous and shocking clue from a past figure.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: After Hee-joo's bold move, her fate and that of her kidnapper remain uncertain. But Sa-eon refuses to give up — leaving no stone unturned to find her.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Sa-eon abandons everything he's worked for, leaving Hee-joo completely alone. But after a clue arrives, she embarks on a journey to reunite with him.
